# NestedAssignmentsUsage

<Badge type="info" text="info" /> <Badge type="info" text="off by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" />

Group: [Code style](/rules/#code-style) · PhpStorm name: `NestedAssignmentsUsageInspection`

Chained assignments such as `$x = $y = 5` pack several writes into one
expression; they are easy to misread and a typo (`=` instead of `+`/`==`)
silently becomes another assignment. Separate statements are clearer.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{3,4,5,6,7,9} [Before]
<?php
function setup() {
    $width = $height = 64;
    $first = $last = "none";
    $p = $q = $r = make_point(1, 2);
    $left = $right = $origin;
    $lo = $hi = -1;

    if ($m = $n = fetch()) {}   // reported, no fix

    $solo = 3;            // not chained
    $k = ($j = 2);        // parenthesised: not reported
    $acc .= $tmp = 'x';   // outer compound: not reported
}
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
function setup() {
    $height = 64;
    $width = 64;
    $last = "none";
    $first = "none";
    $r = make_point(1, 2);
    $q = $r;
    $p = $r;
    $right = $origin;
    $left = $origin;
    $hi = -1;
    $lo = -1;

    if ($m = $n = fetch()) {}   // reported, no fix

    $solo = 3;            // not chained
    $k = ($j = 2);        // parenthesised: not reported
    $acc .= $tmp = 'x';   // outer compound: not reported
}
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 3: Split this chained assignment into separate assignments.</li>
<li>line 4: Split this chained assignment into separate assignments.</li>
<li>line 5: Split this chained assignment into separate assignments.</li>
<li>line 6: Split this chained assignment into separate assignments.</li>
<li>line 7: Split this chained assignment into separate assignments.</li>
<li>line 9: Split this chained assignment into separate assignments.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "NestedAssignmentsUsage": {
      "enabled": true
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore NestedAssignmentsUsage

/**
 * @noinspection NestedAssignmentsUsageInspection
 */
```
